# P24 — Restricted finance revisions and exact money calculations

Status: **blocked_external**. Independent implementation and local P24_A1–A3 are delivered. Actual provider/authority/privacy/human gates remain. P25 has not started.

## Delivered behavior

Migration032;67tables/759columns/90public functions. Three forced-RLS/direct-grant-denied immutable finance tables model cost, budget, expense, reimbursement, fundraising and sales plans. Closed typed inputs include purpose/fund/current same-term beneficiary, optional independently readable deliverable/date, terms/risks, exact lines and optional price/forecast. Member beneficiaries only; external beneficiary policy is not invented. Full interface and money/hash policy: docs/finance.md.

`submit_finance_request` derives the current actor, locks/reuses P21/P22 requester/route/form/CAS/retry behavior and creates request revision, finance snapshot/lines, exact selected P12 manifest, server hash, redacted audit/receipts/outbox in one transaction. Cost amounts are canonical decimal centavo strings, bounded0..9007199254740991; quantity uses exact thousandths up to1000000 with half-up per-line rounding before summation. Forecast quantity can be zero; zero cost and negative forecast margin are supported. No binary floating money. Frontend helpers use BigInt internally and return strings. The typed total supplies an existing configured currency adapter, never a separate caller amount.

Typed cases require a fresh finance snapshot for each later request revision at commit; generic revision cannot bypass it. Legacy unbound generic FIN envelopes remain paused and cannot provide authorization; they can use an explicit typed revision. Immutable old request/evidence/finance snapshots survive new revisions. SHA256/jsonb-v1 binds normalized typed payload, exact request revision UUID and manifest hash for P26. Caller hashes, mutable external URLs and raw private persistence are not trusted.

`read_finance_revision` is currently requester-only with current admission/work access and a redacted access audit. Raw tables/helpers are closed to anon/authenticated/service_role. No finance payload joins/counts/search were added; P23's existing independently authorized envelope metadata is unchanged and conveys no typed/file access. No FIN authority hook, financial authorization, ledger, actual revenue or payment exists in this slice. P25 UI and P26 independent FIN authority are excluded; inherited FIN/MCD fail-closed behavior remains.

Files: migration20261025003200_finance_payload.sql; supabase/tests/finance_payload.test.sql; scripts/test-finance-payload.cjs; src/features/finance/money.ts and money.test.ts; generated database types/count; package test command; docs/finance.md, CONTRACTS/STATE/this checkpoint/plan/evidence. Existing P12/P22/P23 regression evidence is refreshed by actual scripts.

## Design/review

Skill-orchestrator-pro/skill-router selected writing-plans, Ponytail, test-driven-development, council-review and verification-before-completion. Review is by this assistant in-session; **simulated product/security/skeptical perspectives**, no independent reviewers, agents, chats or worktrees. A two-step attach-after-submit alternative could leave an incomplete binding. The atomic typed command reuses settled request/file authority and supports later review without broad finance grants. Actual institutional authority/privacy/evidence rules remain external inputs. Read-only diff review covers RPC grants, helper validation, exact serialization, scope, hash/evidence binding, retries, immutable history, late rollback and P24's bounded scope.

## Failures/corrections

Initial tests failed because the new money module and atomic RPC did not exist. First audited read exposed a missing mandatory audit request UUID(23502); added a fresh audit UUID. Negative tests then caught discarded boolean results from existing schema key/text helpers; explicit closed-object/text checks now reject unknown/empty/malformed content. An expired-beneficiary regression reproduced status-only validation; current joined/ends dates are enforced. Zero-forecast tests failed the cost-line positivity rule; forecast quantity now allows zero while cost lines remain positive, with matching SQL/TypeScript assertions. All corrected cases passed. No failed external gate is erased.
